requirements.rule: Local durable data, no login/backend dependency
Check-in after warmup, exactly ten seconds before first working set
Manual next, rest skip, extra time, pause/resume coexist with automatic flow
Active time capped at forty minutes, no forced filler after early finish
Explicit completion is distinct from automatic time, stop and budget cutoff
Shared session/phase/revision-guarded input contract across app and companion clients
Generic optional starter personalization preserves machine-led default and time budget
Validate saved snapshots and preserve unreadable/legacy originals
Phone imagery prioritizes recognizable machine and target muscles; release assets require review
Exercise/set speech and 5..1 beeps, music-friendly behavior validated on device
Difficulty/split independent; final recommendation incorporates real load and recovery
Portable AI instructions, skill, role prompts, canonical docs and executable maintenance checks
Machine/barbell/dumbbell catalog with muscle imagery and dictionary; expanded choices preserve defaults, saved records and time cap
Selectable program previews, actual previous records and conditional upcoming visits share the real planner
External exercise videos and labeled search fallback; pause before leaving and never claim unverified playback
Optional Apple Health workout export and future Watch heart rate with truthful unsupported state
Guided PPL fills chest/shoulder/triceps, back/rear-shoulder/biceps and legs/core roles with week examples, rep cues and alternatives inside the time cap
